stories.headline: 'I've applied for more than 400 roles' - how young people are facing the job shortage
stories.summary: The BBC has been hearing from young people who are struggling to find work about how they are tackling the challenge.

voices.student_north: Bro 400 applications? That's cute. Hamare placement cell ne 600+ rejections track kiye hain already aur semester abhi baaki hai. BBC waale interviews de rahe hain, hum toh placement coordinator ke calls se hi bhag rahe hain. At least unhe 400 chances mila—humein toh 4 companies ne call tak nahi kiya.
voices.student_south: Bhai 400 applications matlab 400 rejections + 1 interview where that one professor's cousin is the interviewer. At least BBC wale log suffering acknowledge kar rahe hain — hamare placement cell toh bas "market is competitive" bolke disappear ho jaata hai. Tera resume itna bhejna padega ki LinkedIn ko server upgrade karna padega.
voices.professional_north: Bhai 400 applications aur ek job nahi — yeh toh humari company ka appraisal cycle hai. HR ko bhi same energy: "500 CVs aaye, par sab overqualified hain." Aur hum? Ek job mein hi phansa hoon, resignation letter likha hua padha hai ek saal se.
voices.professional_south: Yaar, 400 applications matlab inhe "spray and pray" strategy samjh aa gaya. Humara boss ek email bhejta hai — "urgently required" — aur hum excited ho jate hain. These kids are literally treating job search jaise pesticide kar rahe hain. Atleast they're trying; our generation just refreshed LinkedIn aur sone chala gaya.

voices.professional_north: Bhai, IBC ne 1,400 bade companies ki sudhar di, bad loans half kiye. Aur humara boss? Humara "insolvency resolution" toh ek hi tareeka hai — resign kar ke doosri company join karna. Dekh, corporate restructuring hota hai, personal restructuring bhi hota hai.
voices.professional_south: Bhai, IBC 2.0 matlab ab corporate failures ko bhi update mil gaya. Humein toh abhi bhi version 1.0 pe stuck hain — salary same, targets double. Bank ka bad loan resolve ho gaya, par humara "bad mood" boss kabhi resolve nahi hoga.
